objections.claim: The spec asserts holdout blocks/records are ephemeral per-run artifacts with no cross-version migration, but .faff/holdout/<key>.json is a cross-run store re-read and re-validated through computeHoldoutVerdict on every invocation; a pre-change record carrying a needs-human criterion lacks reason_code, so once the new biconditional constraint lands every such stored record becomes contract-rejected rather than the needs-human value it carried.
objections.disposition_rationale: Round-1 revision split enforcement: writer strict on fresh emissions, contract tolerant of a legacy absent reason_code on cross-run re-validation.
